body: ### Bug fixes - Delete app data trees holding files past the 260 character path limit on Windows without long path support. `--reset-app-data` failed with `WinError 145` after removing part of the seed `pip` image, so later environments got a `pip` that could not be imported, and the staging folder of a killed seed image build failed every later run ([#3568](https://github.com/pypa/virtualenv/pull/3568)) by @darrenhuai and @gaborbernat. - Reseeding an environment with `--symlink-app-data` no longer fails with `FileExistsError` and leaves it without `pip` when `pip` was upgraded or reinstalled by `pip` itself, including bytecode written after that install ([#3577](https://github.com/pypa/virtualenv/pull/3577)) by @gaborbernat. - Stop seeding a release yanked from the package index once the next periodic update or `--upgrade-embed-wheels` runs. The yank flags come from the index `pip` is configured with, so an index that needs keyring credentials or a client certificate keeps its logged releases ([#3570](https://github.com/pypa/virtualenv/pull/3570)) by @AP24110011695 and @gaborbernat. - Stop the `bash`, `csh` and PowerShell activators from adding an empty entry when `PATH` is empty. On POSIX an empty entry searches the current directory, so activating with an empty `PATH` put it on the search path ([#3572](https://github.com/pypa/virtualenv/pull/3572)) by @gaborbernat. ### Performance - Defer eligible imports on Python 3.15 until virtualenv uses them, reducing package and CLI startup time ([#3580](https://github.com/pypa/virtualenv/pull/3580)) by @gaborbernat. [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/virtualenv/21.15.9/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/pypa/virtualenv/compare/21.15.8...21.15.9)
